text:
emma.m (Marketing): ok team — aiming to announce Thu 10:00 PT (t-minus 36h). Need final signoff on changelog, docs links, benchmark blurb, webinar CTA, and lead routing.

roger (Product): 10am PT works. Can we do canary at 11:30 PT for 30m? want to watch metrics and have rollback window.

sahil (Eng): canary window OK. I'll push the rollout config to `release/2026-03-25` and set traffic to 5% -> 50% on green. Deploy bot will post logs.

release-bot (bot): Deployment scheduled: canary at 2026-03-25T11:30:00-07:00 — commit abc1234 — watch: /deploys/1738674321

lina (Docs): docs link ready: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/release/v2.4.0 — changelog draft here: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/release/v2.4.0/changelog (please call out batching and KV-cache improvements)

emma.m (Marketing): Marketing snippet for blog: 'Redwood Inference v2.4: smarter batching, lower per-token costs, and new rollout controls for predictable latency.' We'll attach benchmark chart (p99 latency vs tokens).

sahil (Eng): Bench numbers OK, but call out dataset + config: 'web-chat-50k tokens, fp16, dynamic-batching default'. I'll paste the bench gist.

sahil (Eng): `bench gist: https://gist.github.com/sahil/bench-2.4`

emma.m (Marketing): Webinar slot confirmed Wed 9am PT — but we should drive signups in announcement with CTA + a demo invite. Leads should go to HubSpot list 'v2.4_launch' with UTM `?utm_source=announce&utm_campaign=v2.4`

roger (Product): Routing note: add header X-Redwood-Lead: v2.4 for internal routing, and set the webhook to https://hooks.hubspot.com/forms/v2/submit/REDWOOD/abcd

lina (Docs): I'll update the docs hero banner and include the webinar CTA. Ping me if the CTA copy changes.

emma.m (Marketing): :thumbsup: Final ask — who can be on rotation for first 2 hours after launch? cc @sahil @roger

sahil (Eng): I'll be on for first hour, then @alex (Eng-Oncall) takes second. I'll monitor latency dashboard and rollout.

roger (Product): I'll monitor inbound leads and handoff to SDRs.

emma.m (Marketing): Thanks — locking announce at 10:00 PT. I'll post final copy in #marketing 30m before.
